objective: Build the iterative CC inference software factory on JiuwenSwarm and prove a real component-to-image-to-lab flow.

architecture.deployment: single Satay host; controller/Manager/worker/runner outside tested container; local image admission

operator_inputs.control_host: Satay: user-named Jetson Orin Nano; inspect actual local hardware/software
operator_inputs.model_provider_profile: discover existing approved configuration; do not export secrets
operator_inputs.allowed_effects: resolve from operator grants; no implied authority expansion

capsules.required_proof: built image contains the intended change; changed path is exercised
real agent reads and follows it; material read grants no execution authority
actual selected binary flags and configuration checked; structured unsupported-input failure
durable job and actual dependency acquisition/build; submission is not success
Manager admission, real inference, durable result acknowledgment
task-scoped immutable records with verified identities

tasks.title: Pin sources and inspect Satay without disturbing its queue
acceptance: Record fetched versus reference pins and preserve unrelated work
Verify local Orin board, JetPack/CUDA, Docker, memory/disk and queue; no Spark provisioning or competing GPU/build job
AI4Research-Main target and CC-v2 donor ancestry are rechecked; preserve concurrent changes

tasks.title: Implement durable shared evidence
acceptance: Same evidence bytes survive process restart
Stale decision revision cannot overwrite a newer decision
Same artifact identity with different bytes is rejected
No success acknowledgment when persistence fails
Cross-task access is denied unless explicitly authorized

tasks.title: Build durable jobs and real Builder
acceptance: Actual build longer than 60 seconds survives client disconnect and reconnect
Identical key and request returns the same job; changed request with same key conflicts
Changed inputs cannot reuse incompatible completed output
Observed cancellation and cleanup; no untracked children or duplicate recovery launch
Pinned dependency preparation and real image construction produce linked receipts
Reuse qualified native jetson-orin recipe; no x86/Spark image substitution

tasks.title: Implement and package six CCs
acceptance: Validate against actual CC-v2 schemas and all material paths
Preserve existing runner receipt/replay/grant behavior
Run live JiuwenSwarm discovery, material read and executable invocation
Treat denied grants and failed receipt states as failures, not normal success

tasks.title: Connect adaptive agent decision loop
acceptance: Controlled actual preflight/config rejection leads to queried evidence and a revised next action
Successful corrected attempt retains original failure and its cost
No hard-coded repair/success transcript
Budget exhaustion yields partial outcome with pending work

tasks.title: Deliver image through Manager to real demo lab
acceptance: Manager admits and verifies the exact local image on Satay; same-host delivery is labeled honestly
Actual model executes with declared settings and frozen scoped correctness check
Wrong target/image, failed correctness and upload failure are distinct outcomes
Manager persists evidence and acknowledges; lab spool retries idempotently
No lab direct write to primary factory evidence storage

tasks.title: Implement the major AI4R revision and verify lineage/migration
acceptance: Target revision is a genuine ancestor of the feature branch
CC-v2 donor changes and legacy removals are reviewed and recorded
One native factory execution path; no AI4R adapter or restored fixed-plan pipeline
Unsupported legacy config fails with a migration explanation
Real factory run through the native JiuwenSwarm entrypoint
Shared AI4Research-Main remains unchanged until separately authorized publication/merge

tasks.title: Rehearse and deliver
acceptance: CC-only running order fits ten minutes
All required live acceptance evidence is linked and reproducible
RSI profiling and second improvement are excluded from readiness
Report cc_demo_ready and ai4r_lineage_and_migration_verified without implying a shared-branch merge

native_factory_entrypoint.note: Native factory interfaces in the resulting AI4Research feature branch, not an AI4R compatibility adapter.

ten_minute_schedule.topic: Skill-guided integration or repair with observed replanning
Builder dependencies, build and image receipt

contract_namespace_note: Historical contract namespace retained; execution host is Satay, not Spark.
